user.title: Neore gateway
user.description: This integration reads the heat pump through neore-gateway; it never logs in to the PLC itself.

data_description.url: Base URL of neore-gateway, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8470
data_description.token: The gateway's bearer token (NEORE_API_TOKEN_FILE). Without it, writable registers are not exposed.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the gateway at this URL (GET /api/health failed).

deprecated_yaml.title: Neore YAML configuration is no longer used
deprecated_yaml.description: The `neore:` block in configuration.yaml and its PLC username and password are no longer used: this integration now reads the heat pump through neore-gateway, which holds the only PLC session. A config entry has been created pointing at the default gateway URL; if that is wrong, open Settings > Devices & services > Neore > Reconfigure. Then remove the `neore:` block from configuration.yaml and restart Home Assistant.

gateway_unreachable.title: Neore gateway unreachable
gateway_unreachable.description: neore-gateway at {url} has not answered for several polls ({error}). Neore entities are unavailable until it answers again. Check that the gateway runs, or change the URL via Settings > Devices & services > Neore > Reconfigure.
